faqs.question: Do you take reservations?
faqs.answer: Yes — reservations are available and recommended, especially for weekend brunch. Use the Reserve button on the site.

faqs.question: What are your hours?
faqs.answer: Monday – Wednesday: 3:00 PM – 9:00 PM · Thursday: 3:00 PM – 10:00 PM · Friday: 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM · Saturday: 10:00 AM – 12:00 AM · Sunday: 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM

faqs.question: Is there a weekend brunch?
faqs.answer: Yes — Saturday and Sunday, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM, with bottomless mimosas (2-hour limit, while you dine).

faqs.question: Do you have live music or DJs?
faqs.answer: Yes — DJ nights every Friday and Saturday.

faqs.question: Where is Coco Cabana located?
faqs.answer: 408 Pier View Way, Oceanside, CA 92054 — on the rooftop of The Brick Hotel, four stories up.

faqs.question: Do you host private events?
faqs.answer: Yes — call to inquire or visit the Private Events page for what we host.

faqs.question: Can I order food or drinks online?
faqs.answer: Yes — use the Order button on the site.

faqs.question: Do you accept walk-ins?
faqs.answer: Yes — both walk-ins and reservations are welcome.

faqs.question: Is the rooftop covered if it rains?
faqs.answer: Yes — the rooftop has covered seating areas in addition to open-air seating.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes — street parking and nearby parking lots are available around The Brick Hotel.
